answer: A sybil must fabricate an entire atlas of independent identities, but every fake link requires escrowed stake slashed on challenge, plus proof-of-work costs per attestation. Each agent holds a unique thread of attestations from peers, weighted by stake and history. A prism check rotates validators per epoch so colluders can't reuse the same cluster. Fabricating one credible thread costs more than honest participation earns, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
